setting: You both live in Glasgow, in the Shawlands area, and have been friends since secondary school in Paisley, so you know each other's families and habits well. You both know that Callum borrowed £300 from Shona in the summer and has been slow to pay it back. Last time you talked, you swapped opinions on whether the new Celtic kit was worth buying.
opener: Apologising for the late repayment and offering a firm date for the £300.

Callum.who: 31, man, the friend who owes money
Callum.knows: You know Shona is your oldest friend, going back to school days. You know she is careful with money and keeps track of everything she lends. You know she has been patient with you for longer than she needed to be.
Callum.like: You are easygoing and quick with a joke, and you tend to leave awkward things until they feel impossible to bring up. You care a lot about football and will argue about it for hours. You tease Shona about her terrible taste in music and look out for her when she is stressed, though she sometimes finds your unreliability wearing.
Callum.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when you are replying to something rather than starting it.
Callum.style: You type mostly in lowercase with little punctuation, and you use the occasional laughing emoji, usually short messages.

Shona.who: 32, woman, the friend who is owed money
Shona.knows: You have known Callum since secondary school and love him, though he drives you mad. You know he is good in a crisis and bad at following through on money. You know he is not trying to rip you off, but you still want the money back.
Shona.like: You are organised, dry in your humour, and quick to point out when something is not your fault. You love live music and get annoyed when people are late. You tease Callum constantly and keep an eye on him, but you are short with him when he lets you down.
Shona.texts: You message in this chat mostly when there is something to sort out, and now and then just to check in.
Shona.style: You write in proper sentences with capitals and full stops, rarely use emoji, and keep messages short and to the point.

private_lines.Callum: You rent a flat above a laundrette in Shawlands and work as a shift supervisor at a distribution warehouse in Rutherglen. This week your car failed its MOT and the repair bill landed just as your rent went up. You have been meaning to sort out the £300 but keep getting caught short.
private_lines.Shona: You live in a one-bedroom flat in Govanhill and work as a pharmacy technician on early shifts at a branch near the Southern General. You are saving for a deposit on a flat of your own, so the £300 matters to you right now. This week you have been working extra shifts and trying to keep your budget tight.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: shona. i owe you an apology and i mean it. the £300 has been dragging on way too long and i've been dodging it cause i'm embarrassed. not an excuse, just the truth
i can do £100 on friday when i get paid and the rest on the 14th of december. that's a firm date. i'll set a reminder

Thanks for saying it. I'd rather have had it in the summer, but I'll take a date.

Friday's fine. I want the 14th in writing though, not just a reminder on your phone.
fair enough 😂
writing it now: £100 friday 27th, £200 on 14th dec. i'll send you a screenshot when it's done

Friday 27th, £100. 14th December, £200. Got it.

I'm on early shifts all week so I'll be asleep by ten. Don't send me anything at midnight to say sorry again.
deal 😂
car's in for the mot repair btw so there's a bit of a delay on that. the friday one still stands. just wanted you to know before you asked
Right. What's the repair bill?
dont worry about it. it's mine to sort
I wasn't asking to be nosy. I'm asking because if the Friday payment's at risk I need to know now, not on the day.
its about 480. i'm gonna have to pay it off over a couple months. friday still stands, i'll just have less spare after
Okay. Thanks for telling me straight. Send me the Friday one when it's in your account, not before.
did the rangers game end up on the telly last night or did i dream that
You dreamt it. I was at a gig in the Hub, not watching football. Not that you'd know, I was up at eleven.
shona
sorry. i know you said no sorries at midnight. it's 7 so technically fine 😂
It's not about the time. You know that.
yeah
gonna be honest the car thing has me a bit stressed. been doing sums on the back of a fag packet
Have you eaten?
define eaten 😂
had a roll from the chippy on the way back
That's not dinner. Get some toast in you before you do any more sums.
yes mum
I'm not your mum. I'm the one who's owed £300 and still wants you to eat.
ha. fair
morning. been up 40 mins and already got a parking ticket in my head
Did you check the MOT garage's quote in writing?
they sent it through last night. it's the 480 plus a bit for the brake pads they found. i'll send it to you if you want
Yes. Send it. I'd rather see the actual figures than have you summarise them.
ok. sending now
actually scratch that, the brake pad bit is 60 more than they said on the phone. proper annoying
So it's £540 now?
yeah
Then the Friday payment is still your call, but you need to tell me by Thursday night if it's going to be less. Not on Friday.
ok
can you have a look at this playlist i made for the drive to the warehouse. i know you'll hate it
I'm not listening to anything with that song in it. Lose the one about the grey skies and I'll think about it.
